'''Scott Hickey''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2000 Cincinnati tournament]] in March 2000 with Yavin Clouds, according to Frank Lamantia's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d355">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-18-cincinatti-ohio-3-21-00d355/ cincinatti-ohio-3-21-00], DeckTech (Frank "FrankLamanti" Lamantia, 18 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-18-cincinatti-ohio-3-21-00d355/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
